Without a search it reaches the field, but the trigger still reads "Select…". The platform path that covers it: the "Browse all records" grid beside it works, and a required field refuses a missing value loudly. Who reaches it: every lookup in Setup dialogs and forms (Delegations, Set Manager, Business Units parent; objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188 F-13).

The card had no comment at this claim. It is filed under the maintainer's 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`).
Serial constraints cleared: no open objectui PR touches `LookupField.tsx`. Fold-or-serial: queued objectui#13123 (the select badges in an option's preview line are cut off) shares `LookupField.tsx`. It is not folded, because it fails fold gate ①: preview-line layout, not commit and label state. It runs after this card.

Why `Clause-②: no`: the fix is inside `@object-ui/fields`' widget behaviour. No export, prop or accept set moves. If the route needs a new prop, the dev stops and reports.

      "question": "A click aimed at the quick-picker rows shown BEFORE the debounced search answer lands can reach no row.         "A — accept it. A click that reaches a row always commits it; the miss needs the list to change between aim and press. Startup scope: zero cost.",

Rows would show and vanish when the two disagree, and the renderer would grow its own opinion of what matches. AI-error: a tolerant client path that masks server search gaps. Startup scope: new behaviour plus its tests.",
